Summary: Mid-market ecommerce CX org exploring RAG for agent-assist + ticket deflection. Focused on embeddings scale (tens of millions of docs), top-5 rerank quality, and strict latency SLOs for agent UX.

Recent activity: 
- 2026-02-12: Demo + architecture walkthrough (Fireflies ff_2026-02-12_htd-demo-01). Showed Redwood dedicated pool + private control plane. AE (Maya) + SE (Liam) on call.
- 2026-02-20: POC kickoff email thread created (msgid:1726b2c3_hightide-eval-thread). Agreed dataset: 12M historical tickets + 33M KB sentences -> target index ~45M embeddings.
- 2026-02-25: Ingest test complete (small scale). Measured embedding generation 350 docs/sec on initial infra; need batching/quantization advice. Jira RDW-1129 logged for ingestion connector issues.
- 2026-02-27: Retrieval + rerank micro-benchmark: recall@50 0.84 (baseline), top-5 precision 0.62 with CPU-based reranker; 3x latency vs SLO. Ticket RDW-1148 created to capture reranker performance blockers.

Requirements / Goals (customer-specified):
- Indexing scale: target 40-60M vectored items for first rollout; expect steady-state +15% monthly growth.
- Traffic: initial peak 60 QPS queries (support search + agent-assist) with seasonal spikes to 150 QPS.
- Latency SLO: interactive agent path p95 end-to-end <= 250ms, p99 <= 450ms. Retrieval+rerank must usually finish within 120-180ms.
- Quality: top-5 rerank precision >= 0.75 (customer measures via labeled dev set), stable across KB updates.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost/query <= $0.015 (embeddings + retrieval + rerank). If cost > target, adoption is unlikely.
- Security: VPC/private deployment mandatory for EU customer-subset; must support SSO (SAML), SOC2, audit logs, and KMS-managed keys.
- Data residency: portions of the corpus must remain in EU region; need hybrid routing.

POC scope and success metrics:
- Run 4-week Private pilot in EU with 10M items, 50 QPS load, and Redwood Optimize recommendations applied.
- Deliver: ingestion pipeline docs, cost projection for 45M index, latency profile (p50/p95/p99), and top-5 precision >= 0.72 as interim success.

Customer voice / quotes (paraphrased):
- "We will only move to Redwood if we can hit agent latency targets — agents can't wait more than ~200ms for retrieval or they'll abandon."
- "We care about top-5 results — we judge reranker by whether useful answer is in the first five, not top-1 necessarily."

Technical notes captured by SE:
- Consider GPU-quantized reranker model for p95 improvements; evaluate model variants suggested by Optimize.
- Need advice on continuous indexing vs batch windowing; customer prefers near-real-time updates (10-15 minute freshness).
- Plan to enable prefix/KV caching for hot tickets to reduce cost.
- Routing policy: EU-resident docs must be served from EU nodes; non-EU can be NA. Need multi-region model routing with consistent ranking.
